description: Daily collateral-eligible holdings (担保券) series for one A-share: `collateral_shares`, `collateral_shares_chg`, `prev_collateral_shares`, `collateral_mv_cny`, `total_mv_cny`, `collateral_pct_of_total_mv` (collateral value as % of total cap, percentage points — a high and rising share means more of the float is exposed to forced liquidation). **T+1, published later than `margin_show`** (may lag by a day). Coverage is wider than the margin list, so presence here without `margin_show` is not a gap. `null` = not published, not zero.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

days.description: Look-back window in calendar days (1-250, default 60). Ignored when from/to given.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `to`.

to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Must be given together with `from`.

name: margin_collateral
